title: Build a path-pattern matcher and ordered router
prompt: Implement compilePattern and matchPath in src/pattern.js and createRouter in src/router.js, then re-export compilePattern, matchPath, and createRouter from src/index.js. Use ES modules and only Node built-ins. Paths must start with '/', must not contain '//', and at most one trailing slash is ignored; '/' is the root. compilePattern(pattern) returns an array of segments in which a static segment stays a string and a ':name' segment becomes { name }. Parameter names must match /^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$/ and may not repeat; static segments may not contain ':' or '*'. matchPath(pattern, pathname) returns a plain object of captured parameter strings (an empty object for a static match) or null when the segment counts or static segments differ. Captured values are returned verbatim with no percent-decoding. createRouter(routes) validates an array of { method, path, handler } objects and returns { match(method, pathname) }. Methods are trimmed and compared case-insensitively; the first matching route in array order wins. A successful match returns { handler, params, method, path } where method is uppercase and path is the original route path; no match returns null. Reject malformed patterns, malformed routes, duplicate parameter names, invalid arguments, and non-string paths with an Error. createRouter must not mutate routes.
